notes: Model EF-DL3-A. Battery protection parts are on the inverter module, not a separate BMS board.

gaps: Notebookcheck's article on the Delta 3 1000 Air gives 960 Wh and 500 W rated (up to 800 W in X-Boost), which differs from the teardown's 950.4 Wh.
method: ChargerLAB teardown (page title and unit label: EF-DL3-A) gives a 3S LiFePO4 pack labelled 950.4 Wh (9.6 V, 99 Ah) and X-Boost as 1000 W.

comps.spec: Automotive-grade LiFePO4 pack, configured as a 3S connection of LiFePO4 cells. Label capacity 950.4 Wh (9.6 V, 99 Ah); measured voltage about 9.89 V.
Bi-directional inverter module. Label: AC output (discharging only) 220 V, 50 Hz, 500 W max; bypass mode 220-240 V, 50/60 Hz, 500 W max. Intro says X-Boost raises output to 1000 W.
MPPT solar charging input, 12-60 V DC, 15 A, 500 W max, on an XT60 connector. Page names an MPPT heatsink beside the step-down choke.
TI BQ7694202 (TQFP48) battery protection IC; supports 3-series to 10-series lithium-ion and lithium iron phosphate battery applications. Shown on the bi-directional inverter module.
CRMICRO CRSM013N06N4Z (DFN5x6) NMOS, 60 V, 1.1 mΩ; battery protection MOSFETs, configured in a 6-parallel connection with opposing series arrangement.
Two 0.5 mΩ current-sense resistors, used to detect battery pack current.
VICFUSE SMD fuse, 100 A, 72 VDC; battery pack overcurrent protection.
Two thermistors on the battery pack, secured by white thermal potting compound.
Copper busbars with red and black heat-shrink connect the pack to the inverter module. Voltage-sense wires are spot-welded.
CRMICRO HGQ024N04A (PDFN5x6) NMOS, 40 V, 1.6 mΩ; inverter step-up and synchronous rectification, mounted beneath the heatsink.
CRMICRO CRJT190N65GCF (TO-220) NMOS, 650 V, 181 mΩ; LLC switching MOSFETs.
UTC UC2845G (SOP-8) current-mode controller; page calls it the auxiliary power control chip.
TI LM393LV dual comparator (marked L393LV) and TI TLV9062 dual op-amp (marked T062).
Transformer wound on a PQ35 magnetic core, with a bakelite insulation board at the bottom.
JH CD261X series long-life caps, spec 500 V 100 µF, two connected in parallel (resonant and HV filter caps); CapXon HV filter cap, spec 22 µF 450 V.
HF HF140FF/012-2HSW, two normally open sets, 12 A/250 V, 12 V coil.
YINGTIAN YTD126015SQH cooling fan, 12 V, 0.3 A.
comps.loc: Shown in the teardown photos after the metal baseplate under the inverter module

comps.spec: Page describes an MPPT heatsink beside the step-down choke; another above the step-down choke (filter caps left, transformer right); and a right-side heatsink for the LLC and totem-pole PFC MOSFETs.
SMD fuse at the input end, spec 20 A (follows the XT60 DC input socket caption). A fuse at an input end with outer heat-shrink tubing is also shown.
GigaDevice GD32F303RCT6A (LQFP64), a pair: one for low-side and LLC control, one for PFC and inverter modulation.
Churod A1-S-112HA2, one normally open set, 10 A/250 V, 12 V coil.
Two 1 mΩ resistors in parallel for inverter output current sensing.
NOVOSENSE NSM2015-100B5F (SOW16) integrated current sensor, 100 A range, 5 V supply, 1550 VDC working insulation voltage.
CRMICRO CRST024N10N4Z (TO-220) NMOS, 100 V, 2.1 mΩ; two switching MOSFETs secured on the heatsink.
CRMICRO CRSM043N10N4 (DFN5x6) NMOS, 100 V, 3.8 mΩ; switching MOSFET for power-supply control.
TI UCC27211A-Q1 (marked 27211Q) automotive-grade 120 V driver with 8 V UVLO; a second one of the same model is shown.
TI UCC23513B single-channel isolated gate driver with optocoupler-compatible inputs.
TI LM5108 100 V-rated half-bridge gate driver, 2.6 A sink / 1.6 A source.
NOVOSENSE NSD1624ED non-isolated half-bridge driver for MOSFETs or IGBTs.
GigaDevice GD25Q64ESIG (SOP8) 8 MB memory chip; page labels it Memory.
PINGWEI TMBF310 (TMBF package) rectifier bridge, 1000 V, 3 A.
STE 5D820K varistor, used for absorbing overvoltage surges. Page also lists STE 14D471K and 14D621K varistors.
TRX TAY2332ME SMD Y capacitors, two in series for safety.
XT60 solar charging input socket, 12-60 V DC, 15 A.
IEC AC power socket, reinforced by soldering.
Richtek RT6283B (SOP-8) synchronous step-down, 4.5-30 V in, 0.8-24 V out, 3 A.
MPS MP9487 (SOIC-8) step-down regulator, 4.5-100 V in, 1 A.
CHIPOWN PN8054P (SOP8) non-isolated step-down, 690 V switch, 15 V output.
JOULWATT JW5513 (QFN3x3-20) synchronous step-up, 2.6-20 V in, up to 20 V out.
TI TPS62933F (SOT583, marked 933F) synchronous step-down, input up to 30 V, 3 A, output up to 22 V.
TI TPS62A01 (SOT-563, marked 1J7) synchronous step-down, 2.5-5.5 V in, 1 A.
Espressif ESP32-C6-MINI-1 wireless communication module: Wi-Fi 6 and BLE, onboard PCB antenna.
